verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents importing existing purchase data, either server-side by sending Apple receipts and purchase tokens to the `POST /receipts` REST endpoint or client-side. That covers bringing existing store subscriptions in, but it is receipt/token-based rather than a spreadsheet or competitor-platform import, and nothing in the pack covers card data. Missing for 10: spreadsheet/CSV import, documented migration from competing platforms, PCI-compliant card data transfer, evidence of a customer-invisible cutover, and independent or hands-on corroboration of migrations.
